correctness.rationale: For q_epsilon=(s^4-t^4,s^2t^2+epsilon s^4,t^2,s^2-st,st), the two Cox coprimeness conditions hold for every parameter because v2=t^2 and v3=s(s-t) never vanish simultaneously and u0 is nonzero when w=st=0. The selected epsilon-independent 3x3 minors of the 5x3 Cox differential are -4t^2(3s^4+t^4), -4s(s-t)^2(s^3-st^2-2t^3), and 4st^2(2s-t); independently reconstructed symbolically. If s=0 or t=0 one of the first two minors is nonzero; if st != 0 and all minors vanished the third forces t=2s, contradicting the first (-304s^6). Therefore the differential rank is three globally in characteristic zero. Using Iwasaki Appendix A.1, an independently reconstructed full 16x16 relative cohomology matrix has exact determinant 4096 epsilon(1-4epsilon), rank 15 at epsilon=0 and 1/4, and rank 16 away from those roots. For rank-two degree-12 normal N=O(a)+O(12-a), a<=6, h0(N(-7))=6-a equals the matrix corank. Consequently N=O(5)+O(7) at both roots, balanced O(6)^2 elsewhere; simple determinant roots define reduced pullback divisor V(epsilon(1-4epsilon)). The source Cox resolution/determinantal scheme interpretation supplies the nonstandard geometric identification; computations verify its actual special matrix, not merely a prerecorded VERIFY_OK log.
